metadata.description: Captured POST /api/mdm/updates/{updateUuid}/groups/{organizationGroupUuid}/deployment when a deployment for the same update+org group already exists — 409 with errorCode 5206 (DeploymentExists). Wire-vs-canonical disagreement: canonical docs describe a `self` link pointing at the existing deployment; the actual body has no `self` field at all — the existing deployment's uuid is embedded only inside the free-text `message` string, alongside a generic `activityId` correlation field. Shape confirmed against 26.4.0.0 live capture: identical errorCode 5206, same message format with UUID embedded in text, same {errorCode, message, activityId} three-field body with no self link.

body.message: Deployment with deployment uuid ec4a352b-6409-c5a7-84b0-6c192258c3ba already exists.
